decision_conditions:
<ol style="margin-top:0cm" start="1" type="1">
 </ol><p style="margin-top: 0cm; margin-bottom: 0cm; margin-left: 5.35pt;">The local planning authority is
     unable to undertake a detailed assessment of the development, as the
     scheme has failed to provide sufficient information related to the
     provision of artificial ventilation of the restaurant dining area to the
     side and rear of the site. This thereby may result in the loss of
     residential amenities to the surrounding properties due to undue
     disturbance and also potential adverse visual impacts upon the character
     and appearance of the Stanmore Hill Conservation Area and nearby listed
     buildings from such infrastructure. It is considered that the imposition
     of planning conditions would not provide satisfactory assurance to the
     planning authority that these matters could be adequately dealt with and
     would therefore be contrary to Harrow Development Management Policies DM1,
     DM7 and DM 38A.b and London Plan Policies D4, D14 and HC1.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p><ol style="margin-top:0cm" start="1" type="1">
</ol>
description: Change of Use from retail (Class E) to cafe/restaurant (Class Eb); single storey rear extension; installation of extract flue to rear (demolition of five storage units and conservatory)
